analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free caused by replacing an atom object (RWMol::replaceAtom deletes the old Atom) after SGroup parsing state has already captured/relies on bookmark->Atom* identity. Later, SGroup SPA processing calls SubstanceGroup::addParentAtomWithBookmark(), which resolves a bookmark to a stale Atom* and dereferences atom->getIdx(), triggering UAF in Atom::getIdx(). The crash manifests in SubstanceGroup::addParentAtomWithBookmark (SubstanceGroup.cpp:82) but the root cause is unsafe atom replacement during ParseMarvinSmartsLine without revalidating/updating bookmark-backed references used later in ParseMolBlockProperties.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In MolDataStreamToMol() / ParseMolBlockProperties(), input must include both: (1) an MRV SMARTS property line that reaches ParseMarvinSmartsLine and causes mol->replaceAtom() on an existing bookmarked atom, and (2) subsequent SGroup V2000 vector data (notably SPA, possibly SAL/SBL context) that resolves bookmarks via getUniqueAtomWithBookmark() and dereferences the returned atom. Because the old atom was freed by replaceAtom but bookmark-based lookup still yields/depends on stale pointer state, later SPA handling in ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine -> addParentAtomWithBookmark dereferences freed memory.
